scientific_integrity: The derivation block equations and finite-field projection/central-shear enumeration are fully proved. The characteristic-sensitive maximal rank and concentration estimate follow from exact algebraic identities. The stand-alone verifier corroborates four small exhaustive cases. There is no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only free class-two nilpotent Lie algebras V plus exterior-square V over finite fields are treated. The asymptotic assertion requires fixed q of characteristic two. Prime-field verifications in dimensions two and three do not cover all q or n; the proof does. The novelty comparison is provisional, not a proof of priority.
title: Characteristic-two rank expansion for idempotent derivations of free class-two Lie algebras
